messages:
rory (Marketing): Quick sync — aiming to ship the 'Beacon' announce next Tue 11:00am PT. Need final changelog, canonical docs URL, a 1-paragraph bench blurb + 3 bullets for the slide deck, and a staging webhook for webinar regs by EOD Mon.
dima (Engineering): Working on changelog PR #10021. I'll include the canary windows, rollback CLI, and an example `beacon.yaml` snippet for Dedicated customers.
dima (Engineering): Also adding a short note about expected perf delta on long-context prompts (we ran 8k and 16k sweeps).
elli (Docs): I can publish /docs/beacon-release once PR merges. Please put the migration checklist (Dedicated vs Hosted) and the example config in the changelog PR so I can copy it verbatim. Need the stable link, not a preview.
john (Product): Webinar booked Thu 10am PT. Marketing wants a 25-40 word teaser for the registration + 3 bullets for the slide (latency/cost/migration). Also need the inbound mapping to Marketo/SFDC for registrants.
rory (Marketing): For the promo we'll use one sentence + bullets. Also want 1 sentence on what changes for Dedicated customers so support gets fewer tickets.
dima (Engineering): Draft bench para: "Beacon lowers median latency by ~31% on 8k contexts and reduces per-token inference cost by ~33% through adaptive batching and quant-aware kernels; includes optional session-prefetching to stabilize p95 under sustained traffic."
dima (Engineering): Bullets: 1) ~31% median latency improvement (8k), 2) ~33% per-token cost reduction with adaptive batching + quant, 3) session-prefetch option for consistent p95 on hot sessions.
rory (Marketing): That reads well. Can you trim to ~30 words for the promo and give a 1-line CTA for the webinar?
dima (Engineering): Promo (30w): "Beacon: faster responses, lower inference cost — live demo + migration tips." CTA: "Register to see Beacon in action and get migration guidance."
elli (Docs): Will publish the page and drop the canonical link here once changelog merges. ETA tomorrow AM if the PR lands tonight.
john (Product): For rollout timing, Engineering please confirm canary cadence. We're going to call out 'staggered canary' in the post. Marketing wants the exact windows and the rollback CLI to include in the changelog.
dima (Engineering): Canary plan: 5% -> 25% at 30m -> 60% at 90m -> 100% at 3h if health passes. Rollback: `rictl rollback --release beacon --to previous`. I'll paste the CLI and metrics to watch in the PR.
rory (Marketing): Great. GTM ops: need a staging webhook endpoint + test key for the registration flow so we can validate field mapping to SFDC (lead.owner, campaign, lead.source).
gtm-bot: Webhook created (staging): https://hooks.staging.redwood/growth/beacon-reg  test key: sk_test_BEACON_XXXX, expires in 7d. Mapping: lead.owner, lead.campaign, lead.source.
elli (Docs): Once I publish canonical URL I'll also add a short migration note: "Dedicated customers: set `session_prefetch: true` in your `beacon.yaml` and bump the reserved pool to handle warm KV caches."
rory (Marketing): Nice — we'll include that as a callout box in the post. One more ask: can Engineering provide a single-line quote (<=20 words) we can attribute to Product/Eng about user impact?
dima (Engineering): Quote: "Beacon delivers faster interactions and lower inference costs for long-context workloads."
rory (Marketing): Perfect — I'll slot that into the post hero. Elli, drop the canonical link here when live and we'll schedule the announcement. I'll also share the slide draft Tue night for review.
elli (Docs): Published: https://docs.redwood.com/release/beacon. Dropping link here for the post and webinar CTAs.
rory (Marketing): Got it, thanks everyone. Locking post draft, will ping when final changelog is merged so we can publish at Tue 11:00am PT. :rocket:
